title: Funcommands
description: A powerful all-in-one fun and utility plugin for modern Minecraft servers.
body:
### ⚡ **Features**
## **Fun Commands**

    /slap <player> – Slap players with configurable damage and knockback
    /kaboom – Visual explosion (no damage, only effects & knockback)
    /firework (alias: /fw) – Launch fireworks
    /fly [player] – Toggle flight for self or others
    /speed <1-5> [player] – Change walk or fly speed
    /announce <message>
    /announce title <message>
    /announce actionbar <message>
    /announce bossbar <message> delay <seconds>
    /ping

##     **Protection**
    Toggle server-wide protections:
        Fall damage
        Fire & lava damage
        Drowning & void damage
        PvP
        Hunger

    Chat, title, actionbar, and bossbar announcements
    Fully color & format support (&c, &l, etc.)
    Configurable messages and permissions

### **Ping System**

    /ping [player] – Check player ping
    Color-coded results (good / medium / bad)
    Optional tablist integration


## **⚠️ Notes**
    permissions can be editable via config.ym
    “Kaboom” is currently under testing and may change in future updates
    Some features may contain bugs as the plugin is in alpha development
    Cross-server announcements (BungeeCord / Velocity) are planned but not yet released
    FunCommands is in active development and new features are regularly added
